mentions.name: Bearicorn
mentions.description: A self-hosted chat app similar to WhatsApp or Signal. It connects to the user's own server so data isn't stored in the cloud, and it was recently made public after being started as a side project for the builders and their agency clients. It is still in alpha.
mentions.source_excerpt: We started a side project for ourselves and our agency clients, and recently made it public. It's a selfhosted chat, similar to WhatsApp or Signal. The app connects to your own server, so your data isn't stored in the cloud. It's still in alpha, but we're already having a lot of fun with it.
